mapper.insert: INSERT INTO energy_aggregate (enterprise_id, dim_type, dim_id, energy_type_id, period_type, period_start, energy_value, cost_amount, data_count, missing_count, calc_version, create_time, update_time, deleted) SELECT d.enterprise_id, 4, d.device_id, d.energy_type_id, #{periodType}, ${bucket}, ROUND(SUM(d.energy_value), 4), ROUND(SUM(d.energy_value * IFNULL(et.price, 0)), 2), COUNT(*), 0, #{version}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 FROM energy_detail d LEFT JOIN energy_type et ON et.id = d.energy_type_id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.device_id IS NOT NULL AND d.period_start >= #{start} AND d.period_start < #{end} GROUP BY d.enterprise_id, d.device_id, d.energy_type_id, ${bucket} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE energy_value = VALUES(energy_value), cost_amount = VALUES(cost_amount), data_count = VALUES(data_count), calc_version = VALUES(calc_version), update_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO energy_aggregate (enterprise_id, dim_type, dim_id, energy_type_id, period_type, period_start, energy_value, cost_amount, data_count, missing_count, calc_version, create_time, update_time, deleted) SELECT d.enterprise_id, 3, COALESCE(d.line_id, dv.line_id), d.energy_type_id, #{periodType}, ${bucket}, ROUND(SUM(d.energy_value), 4), ROUND(SUM(d.energy_value * IFNULL(et.price, 0)), 2), COUNT(*), 0, #{version}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 FROM energy_detail d LEFT JOIN energy_device dv ON dv.id = d.device_id AND dv.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN energy_type et ON et.id = d.energy_type_id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(d.line_id, dv.line_id) IS NOT NULL AND d.period_start >= #{start} AND d.period_start < #{end} GROUP BY d.enterprise_id, COALESCE(d.line_id, dv.line_id), d.energy_type_id, ${bucket} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE energy_value = VALUES(energy_value), cost_amount = VALUES(cost_amount), data_count = VALUES(data_count), calc_version = VALUES(calc_version), update_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO energy_aggregate (enterprise_id, dim_type, dim_id, energy_type_id, period_type, period_start, energy_value, cost_amount, data_count, missing_count, calc_version, create_time, update_time, deleted) SELECT d.enterprise_id, 2, COALESCE(dv.workshop_id, l.workshop_id), d.energy_type_id, #{periodType}, ${bucket}, ROUND(SUM(d.energy_value), 4), ROUND(SUM(d.energy_value * IFNULL(et.price, 0)), 2), COUNT(*), 0, #{version}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 FROM energy_detail d LEFT JOIN energy_device dv ON dv.id = d.device_id AND dv.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN energy_line l ON l.id = d.line_id AND l.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN energy_type et ON et.id = d.energy_type_id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND (dv.workshop_id IS NOT NULL OR l.workshop_id IS NOT NULL) AND d.period_start >= #{start} AND d.period_start < #{end} GROUP BY d.enterprise_id, COALESCE(dv.workshop_id, l.workshop_id), d.energy_type_id, ${bucket} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE energy_value = VALUES(energy_value), cost_amount = VALUES(cost_amount), data_count = VALUES(data_count), calc_version = VALUES(calc_version), update_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO energy_aggregate (enterprise_id, dim_type, dim_id, energy_type_id, period_type, period_start, energy_value, cost_amount, data_count, missing_count, calc_version, create_time, update_time, deleted) SELECT d.enterprise_id, 1, d.enterprise_id, d.energy_type_id, #{periodType}, ${bucket}, ROUND(SUM(d.energy_value), 4), ROUND(SUM(d.energy_value * IFNULL(et.price, 0)), 2), COUNT(*), 0, #{version}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 FROM energy_detail d LEFT JOIN energy_type et ON et.id = d.energy_type_id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.period_start >= #{start} AND d.period_start < #{end} GROUP BY d.enterprise_id, d.energy_type_id, ${bucket} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE energy_value = VALUES(energy_value), cost_amount = VALUES(cost_amount), data_count = VALUES(data_count), calc_version = VALUES(calc_version), update_time = NOW()
